_comment: SQLDash direct-write collector config. The collector hosts DuckDB.NET + Microsoft.Data.SqlClient in PowerShell 7 (benchmarked winner M2 — see docs/INGEST-DECISION.md). Catalog + registry are PostgreSQL; data is ZSTD Parquet on S3, addressed as s3://<bucket_prefix>-<account>/<data_prefix>/. Secrets never live here: the Postgres password comes from the PowerShell Secret vault and is de-escaped for TCP/scram; S3 auth uses the aws-extension credential_chain.
